home_dir.description: Force a single directory for all WeeChat files. Format: config:data:cache:runtime or single path. Defaults to $HOME/.config/weechat if empty.

run_as_daemon.description: Run WeeChat in background, as a daemon.

log_to_stdout.description: Display log messages on standard output instead of writing them in log file. Incompatible with run_as_daemon.

no_connect.description: Disable auto-connect to servers when WeeChat is starting.

plugins.description: Load only these plugins at startup. Comma-separated string of plugin names.

run_commands.description: Run command(s) after startup. Multiple commands can be separated by semicolons or provided as a list.

use_temp_dir.description: Create a temporary WeeChat home directory and delete it on exit. Incompatible with home_dir.

run_upgrade.description: Upgrade WeeChat using session files generated with command /upgrade -quit.
